# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.

corporate social responsibility program.

BKAMED is a professional and leading manufacturer and exporter of first aid, medical, and healthcare

customers worldwide with efficiency and quality.

* First Aid Products (first aid kits, emergency supplies)
* Wound Care (gauze rolls, medical dressings, bandages, medical cotton, non-woven products, medical
  tapes)

  boxes, hot & cold packs)
* Medical Instruments & Consumables (disposable syringes, catheters, surgical disposables, and other
  medical supplies)

products to over 60 countries and regions, including:
* Europe: United Kingdom, Germany, Spain, Denmark, the Netherlands
* Southeast Asia: Japan, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand
* Africa: Tanzania, Kenya, Mauritius, Angola, Libya, South Africa
* Oceania: Australia, New Zealand
* South America:Ecuador, Venezuela, Chile, Brazil

Our partner channels include hospitals, supermarkets, pharmacies, emergency product suppliers, and
sports & healthcare retailers.

Milestones:
* In 2008, we established our first dedicated factory for first aid products.
* In 2021, we launched our own manufacturing facility specialized in kinesiology tape, self-adhesive
  bandages, and elastic adhesive bandages to meet growing customer demand.

management system backed by a professional QC team of hundreds of skilled personnel. We strictly

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

## Medical disposable products company


Dispotech is a leader among medical disposable products companies in Italy and worldwide. The
company was created by Massimo Mortarotti in 1994: after ten years working the chemical-medical
field in Milan, Mortarotti decided to create a new company dedicated to designing, manufacturing and
supplying of medical disposable products. Dispotech was founded in Gordona, in the Valchiavenna area
in Italy. Today Dispotech is recognised both in Italy and abroad as one of the leading companies in
the production of medical disposable products for various sectors: medical, dental, sports,
promotional and mass retail.

and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

## Welcome to hg

Chongqing Hongguan Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. is a leading supplier of medical consumables with
expertise in R&D, production, and sales. We are proud to have achieved ISO:13485 and ISO:9001
quality system certifications, reflecting our commitment to delivering high-quality products. Our
product range includes medical protection and medical dressings. For sales and consultation, please
feel free to reach out to us.

[Read More...][16]

## Why Choose Us

When it comes to medical consumables, choosing the right supplier is of utmost importance. You want
a supplier that not only produces high-quality products but also adheres to strict quality standards
and has the capability to meet your specific needs. This is where Chongqing Hongguan Medical
Equipment Co., Ltd. shines as a trusted and professional supplier of medical consumables.

What sets us apart from other suppliers in the industry? There are several reasons why you should
choose us as your medical consumables supplier.

First and foremost, Chongqing Hongguan Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. is dedicated to quality. We have
obtained ISO:13485 and ISO:9001 quality system certification, which demonstrates our commitment to
maintaining high-quality standards in both our production processes and the products we deliver to
our customers. This means that when you choose us as your supplier, you can trust that you are
receiving products of the highest quality that meet the stringent requirements of the medical
industry.

In addition to our commitment to quality, we also possess R&D, production, and sales capabilities
all in one. This means that we are involved in every step of the process, from the initial research
and development of our products to the production and ultimately the sales and distribution. This
integrated approach allows us to maintain strict control over the entire process, ensuring that we
deliver top-notch products to our customers every time.

Furthermore, our product range is focused on medical protection and medical dressings. We understand
the critical role that these products play in the medical field, and we are dedicated to producing a
wide range of high-quality items that cater to the specific needs of healthcare professionals.
Whether you are looking for protective equipment such as face masks and gloves, or medical dressings
such as adhesive bandages or wound care products, we have you covered with a comprehensive selection
of products to choose from.

Another reason to choose Chongqing Hongguan Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. as your supplier is our
commitment to customer satisfaction. We understand that our customers have unique needs and
requirements, and we are dedicated to working closely with each customer to ensure that we meet and
exceed their expectations. From providing personalized support to accommodating specific product
requests, we go the extra mile to make sure that our customers are satisfied with their experience.

Additionally, we pride ourselves on our professionalism and reliability. When you choose us as your
supplier, you can trust that we will deliver your products on time and in perfect condition. We
understand the critical nature of medical consumables and we take our responsibility to our
customers very seriously.

In conclusion, there are numerous reasons why Chongqing Hongguan Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. should
be your go-to supplier for medical consumables. From our unwavering commitment to quality and
customer satisfaction to our diverse product range and integrated capabilities, we have everything
you need in a supplier and more. When you choose us, you can rest assured that you are partnering
with a trusted and experienced supplier that is dedicated to delivering nothing but the best.

[appli1]
[app]

the most widely used polymer for spunbond nonwoven fabric production.

Spunbond nonwoven fabric is classified as nonwovens composed of endless filaments,and produced by an
integrated process combining fiber spinning, web formation and embossed bonding finally.

[Read More][59]

simple,its non-toxic/harmless and it biodegradable material.Therefore,it is widely used in packaging
materials, agriculture and horticulture,medical and health materials,filtration materials etc.

#### Detailed Market Analysis

The pharmaceutical industry is undergoing a remarkable digital transformation, supported by concrete
market research and verified statistics. The scale of this transformation is evidenced by the
pharmaceutical digital platform market’s projected growth from $4.92 billion in 2023 to $34.12
billion by 2032, representing a robust CAGR of 24.35%. This growth is driven by widespread cloud
adoption, with approximately 80% of pharmaceutical companies already utilizing cloud computing
solutions and 95% expected to be fully cloud-operational within two years.

The transformation is happening across multiple dimensions, with web-based solutions dominating at
72.27% market share and AI-driven engagement representing 27.05% of patient engagement solutions.
Quality management systems are also evolving, with the market expected to grow from $1.87 billion in
2024 to $3.85 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 12.99%. This digital evolution is particularly strong in
North America, which holds a 43.6% share in patient engagement solutions and 39% of the quality
management software market. Implementation timelines vary by solution complexity, ranging from 3-6
months for modular SaaS deployments to 9-18 months for full-suite implementations, reflecting the
industry’s methodical approach to digital adoption while maintaining compliance with regulatory
requirements.

ABOUT US

For over 80 years, Lenzing has been producing better fibers − with cellulose as our renewable raw
material. Solutions from Lenzing are as inventive as they are effective when it comes to caring for
our partners’ success, the needs of our planet, and the demands of everyday life. We’re glad you’re
here. Feel free to explore. And get in touch if you have any questions.

[learn more][44]

PRODUCT LINES

## Our products are derived from cellulose – the better choice for today and tomorrow

## Partnering for impact – Driving meaningful change in the textile and nonwoven industry through
## strategic alliances

Lenzing drives transformation through strategic partnerships with global sustainability leaders.
From serving on the boards of Textile Exchange and Cascale to co-founding the Renewable Carbon
Initiative, we actively shape standards and practices across the fiber and textile industries.

[get inspired][45]
BRANDS

Stand out in the market with globally-recognized brands that your customers trust and value. Our
TENCEL™, VEOCEL™, LENZING™ ECOVERO™ and LENZING™ brands signal high product quality and responsible
manufacturing practices.

## What you can do with Mergr


### Build targeted lists of private equity firms

Create custom lists based on firm criteria, stated investment focus, or actual acquisition activity.

### Search companies by ownership and acquisition history

Find companies based on current ownership, past acquisitions, or divestitures.

### Filter M&A transactions by key deal attributes

Search transactions by target, industry, deal size, acquirer type, or seller type.

### Identify the most active buyers and sellers

Find private equity firms and corporate acquirers based on transaction activity by industry,
geography, or time period.

### Explore relationships between firms, deals, and advisors

Understand how private equity firms, corporate acquirers, and advisors connect across transactions.

### Search M&A press releases by keyword

Discover past and recent transactions by searching the full text of 100,000+ M&A press releases.

Investment Bankers - Business Brokers - Accountants - Lawyers

are non-woven fabrics with high performance adhesive

## Technologies

[001 Tefisa Tecnologies02][001 Tefisa Tecnologies02]

### Chemical Bonded

In this production process, a liquid binder is applied to the fibers in a directed way, to join them
and create a fabric that offers high resistance to temperature and elasticity, as well as multiple
finishes.
[ Learn more ][107]
[001 Tefisa Tecnologies01][001 Tefisa Tecnologies01]

### Spunlace

Also called Hydro-entangled or tangled thread technique. Use fine jets of high-pressure water to
weave the fibers together, creating soft, comfortable fabrics that are highly tensile.
[ Learn more ][108]
[New Project 2020 07 10t155433.041][New Project 2020 07 10t155433.041]

### Laminated Nonwovens

Technology based on the adhesion of a film to the non-woven. We get a resistant and multifunctional
nonwoven.
[ Learn more ][109]

## Company

**At Murtra Nonwovens (MNW) we manufacture non-woven fabrics and distribute them for use in multiple
sectors: automotive, medical, liquid filtration, construction and agriculture, among others.**

Our range of non-woven fabrics is wide and constantly evolving. That is why Murtra Nonwovens, with
its two production sites in Piera (Barcelona – Spain) and Ystad (Skåne län – Sweden) is one of the
leading companies in its sector.

Furthermore, at Murtra Nonwovens we have our own R&D department where new varieties of nonwovens are
designed, tested and developed. The function of this department is clear: to create exactly the
material that our customer needs.

Murtra Nonwovens is part of Murtra Group, a worldwide benchmark in the textile sector that operates
in 4 divisions: Industrial, Decoration, Non-Woven and Lab.

La aplicación principal de nuestros tejidos no tejidos para agricultura es la elaboración de
planteles.
Construcción
Somos expertos en la fabricación de velo acústico. Desde hace más de veinte años proveemos productos
para su aplicación a paneles divisorios y en falsos techos de acero.
Cosmética
Nuestros no tejidos son excelentes para su uso en productos cosméticos por su suavidad y
transpirabilidad, además de su tacto en contacto con la piel.
Especialidades
Nuestro principal objetivo en Murtra Nonwovens es fabricar el no tejido que nuestros clientes
necesitan. Trabajamos uniendo fuerzas y sinergias para darle vida a todo tipo de proyectos.
Madera
En Murtra Nonwovens fabricamos materiales para el soportado de madera y melamina. Nuestros soportes
son tejidos no tejidos con adhesivo de altas prestaciones.

## Technologies

[001 Tefisa Tecnologies02][001 Tefisa Tecnologies02]

### Chemical Bonded

In this production process, a liquid binder is applied to the fibers in a directed way, to join them
and create a fabric that offers high resistance to temperature and elasticity, as well as multiple
finishes.
[ Learn more ][107]
[001 Tefisa Tecnologies01][001 Tefisa Tecnologies01]

### Spunlace

Also called Hydro-entangled or tangled thread technique. Use fine jets of high-pressure water to
weave the fibers together, creating soft, comfortable fabrics that are highly tensile.
[ Learn more ][108]
[New Project 2020 07 10t155433.041][New Project 2020 07 10t155433.041]

### Laminated Nonwovens

Technology based on the adhesion of a film to the non-woven. We get a resistant and multifunctional
nonwoven.
[ Learn more ][109]

## Company

**At Murtra Nonwovens (MNW) we manufacture non-woven fabrics and distribute them for use in multiple
sectors: automotive, medical, liquid filtration, construction and agriculture, among others.**

Our range of non-woven fabrics is wide and constantly evolving. That is why Murtra Nonwovens, with
its two production sites in Piera (Barcelona – Spain) and Ystad (Skåne län – Sweden) is one of the
leading companies in its sector.

Furthermore, at Murtra Nonwovens we have our own R&D department where new varieties of nonwovens are
designed, tested and developed. The function of this department is clear: to create exactly the
material that our customer needs.

Murtra Nonwovens is part of Murtra Group, a worldwide benchmark in the textile sector that operates
in 4 divisions: Industrial, Decoration, Non-Woven and Lab.

options including materials made from post-consumer recycled plastic bottles, FSC / PEFC cellulose
or viscose, PLA and organic cotton.
